svg.text: Actual dependency wiring: 18 routers → 36 services → 19 repositories → 5 stores + 3 LLM providers
FastAPI route decorators. Thin HTTP — validate, auth, delegate to services via Depends().
All business logic. Constructor-based DI. Services call repositories, never DB directly.
6 PIPELINE STAGES: Resolution → Enhance → Retrieve → Rerank → Reason → Generate
LLMProviderService, PromptTemplateService, LLMParametersService, LLMModelService — created once,
injected into PipelineService → SearchService → ChainOfThoughtService → MessageProcessingOrchestrator
Performance Patterns (added late to fix 48+ queries/request)
PipelineContext: @dataclass(frozen=True) — one composite query, threaded through all stages
ConfigCache: request-scoped dict cache — no TTL, dies with request, prevents duplicate lookups
SearchInput/Output, CollectionInput/Output, ConversationSchema, PipelineContext, StructuredAnswer, ChainOfThoughtSchema, LLMUsage, ...
OutputValidatorService (citation validity, confidence calibration, retry logic) | SearchResultEnricher | QuestionService (suggestions)
Data access only. SQLAlchemy Session injection. Returns DB models, never Pydantic. joinedload() for N+1 prevention.

Collection, Conversation, File, Pipeline, User, Team, LLMProvider, LLMModel, LLMParameters, PromptTemplate, Podcast, Voice, Agent, Question, RuntimeConfig, TokenWarning, UserCollection, UserTeam, UserProvider
Circuit Breaker (CLOSED →5 fails→ OPEN →60s→ HALF_OPEN) | graceful degradation: core RAG works if tools fail
21 workflows: 01-lint → 02-security → 03-build → 04-pytest → 05-ci | weekly audit | deploy (Code Engine, Helm) | docs (MkDocs)
Router → Service → Repository → Model/DB | 9 Docker Compose configs | Terraform + Ansible + Helm
